jobs.title: Hardware Design Validation Engineer - Memory Subsystem - New College Grad 2026
jobs.description: Today, NVIDIA is tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in an inclusive, encouraging environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how we can make a lasting impact on the world. NVIDIA's System Product Team is seeking curious, collaborative, and motivated hardware engineers to take our GPU memory subsystem from first silicon power-on to production. This role sits at the intersection of hardware and software, offering the opportunity to work directly with silicon, board, and firmware teams to shape how NVIDIA products perform from the ground up. What you'll be doing: Planning and performing DDR memory tuning, validation, and feature enablement on NVIDIA products. Reviewing silicon design specifications, component datasheets, board schematics, and layout to inform engineering decisions. Applying knowledge of digital, analog, and computer design to debug and resolve controller, memory, board, and software/firmware level issues across all stages of the product lifecycle. Refining memory bringup and validation strategy by providing feedback and recommendations to silicon, board, and software teams. What we need to see: Recently completed a BS or MS in Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience. 2+ years of relevant experience, including internships, co-ops, or research projects. Understanding of high-speed signal integrity and hands-on experience with oscilloscopes. Familiarity with schematic capture and board design. Working knowledge of PC systems, Windows OS, and Linux. Strong grasp of EE fundamentals with the ability to break down complex problems using first principles. Familiarity with scripting or programming languages such as C, C++, Java, Python, or Perl. Ability to work effectively across teams and time zones in a collaborative, cross-disciplinary environment. Genuine curiosity about technology and a passion for continuous learning. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Experience as a tutor or teaching assistant in an engineering or technical subject. Strong presentation skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts to cross-functional audiences. Hands-on experience with memory subsystem design or validation. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you! Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 108,000 USD - 184,000 USD for Level 2, and 136,000 USD - 212,750 USD for Level 3. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 13, 2026. This posting is for an existing vacancy. NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Certificate Services
jobs.description: Do you want to work at the intersection of security, encryption and every internet-connected device in the world? We're looking for Software Development Engineers to build the services that help our customers secure their websites, APIs and devices with digital certificates that just work. Our organization owns everything "certificates" for Amazon. That includes AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) for managing TLS and other X.509 certificates, AWS Private Certificate Authority (PCA) for private certificate issuance, and AWS Signer for code signing. Our services help customers create, manage, and deploy digital certificates based on strong cryptography and public-key infrastructure (PKI) best practices. Certificate lifetimes are getting shorter and Post-Quantum cryptography is coming, while certificates now secure everything from IoT devices to AI agent workloads. Demand for content signing is growing as creators and publishers look for ways to prove their work is original. Customers need certificate management that runs without manual work at any scale. Certificates sit underneath almost every secure connection on the internet, so the systems you build here protect customer traffic across AWS. We want engineers who question the status quo and push leadership and peers to do the right thing for the right reasons. Good ideas come from every level of the team, and we act on them. You'll choose the right technology for the problem and learn AWS's distributed-systems and deployment-safety practices. If you don't know certificates or PKI yet, you'll learn them here. Key job responsibilities Design, build, and operate distributed services where security and availability can't be compromised. Take ambiguous requirements, clarify the problem with customers and partner teams, and deliver the simplest design that solves it. Own features end to end, from design through testing, deployment, and operations, and make trade-offs between new features and operational work. Participate in on-call, find the root cause of production issues, and deliver permanent fixes rather than workarounds. Improve how the team builds and operates software, including tooling, testing, and deployment safety.
